newsitem.title: USA: ITT plans move of tower at Caesars Las Vegas.
newsitem.headline: ITT plans move of tower at Caesars Las Vegas.

text.p: ITT Corp President of Gaming Peter Boynton said the company will move its new tower being planned for Caesars Palace Las Vegas from the property's east side to its west side to avoid disruption of casino business.
Caesars is undergoing a $900 million expansion scheduled for completion in the second quarter of 1999, but early renovations already have hurt the casino business.
In early September, ITT pre-announced a third quarter shortfall in earnings due principally to lower-than-expected wins at Baccarat tables and construction in Las Vegas.
